decisions.reason: The formwork profile system is a multi-model line close to the core offer and still had its own page in 2019, so keeping it costs little and its value is still open, which makes the option worth holding.
The shuttering magnet block line is a cheap-to-carry consumable that complements the firm's formwork systems, and nothing shows its value has failed, so it stays.
This magnetic formwork component had a page of its own through 2019, which signals continued commitment, and it is inexpensive to keep within the established formwork range.
